description: Complete system overview documenting the three core components: Call Center Transfer Management, Bail Status Processing, and Geographic Compliance Monitoring systems

Detailed documentation of the complex transfer routing algorithms including agent availability scheduling, language preferences, timezone handling, and warm transfer workflow implementation from telnyx_tools.py
Technical documentation of bail status processing algorithms including bond format normalization, eligibility determination rules, and fast-path lookup implementation from telnyx_tools.py
Comprehensive documentation of the geolocation system including provider fallback chains, accuracy calculations, VPN detection, and data flow between components from geo.py
Documentation of core data models and relationships between inmates, cases, agents, locations, and bond records, including schema definitions and relationships
